maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Coastline Bank Mortgage Loan Interest Rates, effective 25 May 2026
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: The rate sheet publishes three owner-occupied LVR bands: <=60%, >60% to <=80%, and >80% — so lending above 80% is offered. The First Home Buyer Loan page footnote reads "Rate applicable to all First Home Buyer Loans under 95%", and the same page states Coastline is "Proudly supporting the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme" (a 95% LVR scheme). 95% is therefore the highest LVR evidenced on public sources; Coastline does not publish an explicit 'maximum LVR' figure.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Coastline Bank Mortgage Loan Interest Rates, effective 25 May 2026
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: Inferred from the rate-sheet band structure breaking at 80% LVR, which is the conventional LMI threshold. Coastline does not publish an LMI policy or an LMI threshold in words — treat as unconfirmed.

notes.value: Rate sheet LVR bands (owner-occupied and investment): <=60%, >60% to <=80%, >80%. The First Home Buyer Loan is priced at a single rate across all three bands.

notes.value: Coastline Bank is a customer-owned bank headquartered in Kempsey on the NSW Mid North Coast. Home loan range: Variable Rate Home Loan, Fixed Rate Home Loan (1/2/3 year), First Home Buyer Loan, Variable and Fixed Investment Home Loans, and a Home Equity Access Loan. Owner-occupied and investment are priced identically on the current rate sheet. Standard variable/fixed carry a $300 establishment fee and an $8 monthly fee; the First Home Buyer Loan has no establishment or monthly fee. Minimum applicant age 18.
notes.sourceTitle: Coastline Bank Mortgage Loan Interest Rates, effective 25 May 2026 + product pages

gaps: Coastline publishes almost no credit policy. Confirmed as broker-distributed (both home loan TMDs list 'mortgage brokers' as a distribution channel with an accreditation condition), but there is no public broker site, product guide, policy-at-a-glance or serviceability calculator.
No servicing buffer, assessment floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis, credit-card assessment rate or commitment treatment published.

No maximum LVR is stated in words anywhere — the 95% figure is assembled from the >80% rate band, the 'First Home Buyer Loans under 95%' footnote and 5% Deposit Scheme participation. Verify with the lender before relying on it.
No minimum or maximum loan amount published.
No LMI policy, provider or waiver-profession list published.
No income-type, employment-tenure, credit-history or residency/visa policy published.
No security policy beyond 'registered first mortgage over real property' — no minimum unit size, postcode list, high-density or rural rules.
Lending area is not stated; as a NSW Mid North Coast mutual there may be a geographic restriction that is simply not published.
The Standard Variable TMD used for the 30-year term is dated 5 October 2021 (last reviewed September 2024) and may be stale.
